Markets.title: Avenue Supermarts shares fall 4% despite 18% YoY revenue growth in Q2 update
Markets.summary: Avenue Supermarts reported an 18.4% year-on-year revenue increase to Rs 19,206.18 crore for the second quarter and operated 518 stores as of September 30, 2026. Despite this growth, the company's shares dropped 4.07% on the NSE due to market concerns, alongside issuing Rs 500 crore in commercial paper.

Markets.title: Can Nifty break the 8-week deadlock or will pain continue? Here’s what charts indicate
Markets.summary: Nifty recently rebounded from its longest weekly losing streak in 25 years, but technical indicators suggest the broader downtrend remains intact. If the index breaks below its key support level between 21,743 and 22,182, it could fall further to 19,000 or 16,700.

Markets.title: Nifty rebounds after record 8-week rout, but is this a dead cat bounce investors should fear?
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices rebounded about 1% on Monday after suffering a record eight-week losing streak. Investors remain uncertain whether this recovery marks a lasting market bottom or just a temporary relief rally.

Markets.title: ESDS Software shares hit 5% lower circuit, crash nearly 30% in 6 sessions. What's behind the selloff?
Markets.summary: ESDS Software shares hit the 5% lower circuit on Monday, extending a six-session losing streak to a total decline of nearly 30%. The selloff was driven by the expiry of a one-month shareholder lock-in and investor concerns over weaker sequential Q1 revenue and profit against a stretched valuation.

Markets.title: Global Market: Hang Seng dips as real estate, financial shares face selling pressure
Markets.summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index dipped 0.08% by midday as selling pressure hit real estate and financial shares. Meanwhile, technology stocks gained 0.3% while trading remained subdued due to mainland China's National Day holiday.

Markets.title: 5 global market themes investors need to watch this week
Markets.summary: Global markets face volatility this week due to high borrowing costs, expensive oil, and tightening monetary policy. Investors are closely monitoring events including France's fiscal crisis, Brazil's election, and Federal Reserve minutes for clues on inflation and interest rates.

Geo-Political.title: Right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round of Brazil election
Geo-Political.summary: Right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro won the first round of Brazil's election without securing a majority of the vote. The election will proceed to a run-off scheduled for 25 October.

Geo-Political.summary: The US Air Force has removed all bombers from the RAF Fairford military base in Britain. Authorities have not provided a reason for the withdrawal, which follows a security incident involving suspicious vehicles near the base last week.

Geo-Political.summary: France's education minister announced that up to 500 schools will partially or completely suspend classes on Monday. The closures follow violent clashes between student protesters and riot police.

Data & Insights.summary: Despite upcoming rate hikes, India's credit growth is expected to remain strong in the short term. This resilience is driven by solid economic growth, sufficient liquidity, and ongoing structural demand.

Data & Insights.summary: Most economists surveyed by Mint expect the Monetary Policy Committee to raise the key repo rate to 5.50% on October 7. This potential 25 basis point increase comes as inflation risks mount.

Data & Insights.summary: Despite soaring energy costs and factory selling prices rising at near-record rates, manufacturers continue to expand their operations. High oil prices may now be shifting the types of products these factories are choosing to make.

Data & Insights.summary: Economists predict the Reserve Bank of India will raise the repo rate by 0.25 percentage point during its October 2026 policy meeting. This anticipated rate hike is driven by rising inflation risks stemming from the ongoing West Asia crisis.

Data & Insights.title: GST arrest powers may be removed? Council to discuss decriminalisation on Wednesday; law change likely in Winter Session
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council is meeting to discuss removing arrest powers under the indirect tax regime due to concerns over how businesses are treated. A law change to decriminalize certain offenses is likely to be introduced during the upcoming Winter Session.

India.title: Opinion: Opinion | India's $18.3 Billion Forex Reserve Shock Is A Warning, Not Just A Number
India.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves recently dropped by $18.34 billion in a single week. This significant decline serves as an economic warning for the country rather than just a large financial figure.

India.title: Doctors Turn Delhi-Aizawl Flight Into Emergency Ward, Save Critically Ill Passenger
India.summary: A passenger travelling for a kidney check-up became critically breathless with a 40 percent oxygen saturation level aboard a Delhi-Aizawl flight. Doctors on the plane converted the flight into an emergency ward to save his life.

India.title: World Teachers' Day 2026: Wishes, Quotes, And  Messages You Can Share Today
India.summary: World Teachers' Day 2026 marks the 60th anniversary of the 1966 ILO/UNESCO Recommendation concerning the status of teachers. People are sharing wishes, quotes, and messages today to honor educators and acknowledge these international teaching standards.

India.title: Alimony, Son's Health, Debt: What Drove Techie To Jump From Noida Highrise
India.summary: A Noida software engineer died by suicide after jumping from a high-rise building. Police stated that he recorded a video citing debt, alimony issues, and his son's health as reasons for his distress while holding himself responsible.
